chunks: That Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام was brought a grave robber. So he took him by his hair and struck him against the ground, then said, "Step on him, O servants of Allah." So he was trampled until he died.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.فَوُطِئَ: he was stepped on or trampled
key_terms.نَبَّاشٍ: a grave robber; one who exhumes graves unlawfully

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith report about the punishment of a grave robber by Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report narrates that Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام dealt severely with a grave robber brought before him. The hadith appears in the context of legal punishments and reflects a punitive response to a grave violation.
